This Application has been filed for quashing the entire proceedings of Special Sessions Trial No.08 of 2021, "State of Uttarakhand vs. Jagmohan Kafola", pending before the court of Special Sessions Judge (Anti- Corruption)/IInd Additional District & Sessions Judge, Haldwani, District Nainital under Sections 409, 420, 466, 467, 468, 471, 120B of the Indian Penal Code, 1860, Section 13(1) (d)
read with Section 13 (2) of the Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988.
2.

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: In scholarship scam matter, a Special Investigation Team was constituted in compliance with the order of this Court passed in Writ Petition (PIL) No.33 of 2019.
3. Heard Mr. Amar Murti Shukla, learned counsel for the applicant and Mr. Tumul Nainwal, learned Assistant Government Advocate with Mr. Chitrarth Kandpal, learned Brief Holder for the respondent.

4. Mr. Amar Murti Shukla, Advocate submitted that the allegation against the present applicant is that the applicant, the then District Social Welfare Officer, Nainital, released the scholarship without any physical verification of the concerned students.
There was no provision for physical verification of the concerned students of the institute, located outside the State of Uttarakhand.
The institute-in-question was located outside the State of Uttarakhand.
No reliable evidence has been found against the applicant during the investigation to connect the applicant in the said offence.
5. Mr. Tumul Nainwal, Assistant Government Advocate has sought three weeks' time to file counter affidavit.
Till then, further proceedings of the said Special Sessions Trial No.08 of 2021 are stayed.

(Alok Kumar Verma, J.) 02.01.2026 JKJ/Pant "State Of Uttarakhand vs Jagmohan on 2 January, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/160898676/
